bodyHtml:
Data note: This automated snapshot was updated on 2026-07-23 from public NPM package metadata. Metrics can change after collection. No independent product testing or endorsement is claimed.

Snapshot Summary

prisma is listed in our Backend feed. The source describes it as: Prisma is an open-source database toolkit. It includes a JavaScript/TypeScript ORM for Node.js, migrations and a modern GUI to view and edit the data in your database. You can use Prisma in new projects or add it to an existing one.

The principal source-specific signal in this snapshot is 14.8M downloads in the recorded weekly NPM window.

Evaluation Checklist

  • Confirm currency: Check the primary source for releases and documentation published after this snapshot.
  • Assess fit: Compare supported environments, maintenance activity, dependencies, and license terms with your requirements.
  • Interpret metrics carefully: Treat download volume as distribution activity, not unique users or GitHub growth.
  • Validate important claims: Prefer primary documentation and reproducible evidence.
